title: Festive atmosphere
text: Friendly and fun environment, beautiful swimming at 7 PM when the sun is setting. The food is not exceptional, but then again, one chooses more for the atmosphere than anything else, and I can assure you that the group dances involved everyone! Well done and thank you.

title: Great day trip!
text: This was a fun and full day of adventure! My friend and I had a great time- except the tour started over an hour late which was upsetting so our time got cut short. The boat ride was bumpy but nice with some music and splashes from the water!

title: Gorgeous sunset and swim trip
text: Excellent fun! The crew cares about safety (1st) and fun. Beautiful sunset ride and swim time was outstanding. The crew offered life vests or you can swim without. There were also 2 floating rafts that you can sit on. No rush to swim and move on. Views of the city especially at sunset-beautiful.
author: V8958JCmarim

title: Perfect!!!
text: Awesome!! Welcoming, Mood, music, setting and people, other guests on the boat everything was perfect... our best time in Barcelona. The awesome swimming stop. The staff speaks several French English Spanish languages. There were EVJFs and EVGs as well as an anniversary. Average age thirty. Mood was on the appointment really I recommend 300%! Thank you Sensation BCN
